title: CLIP-Based Image Retrieval: A Comparative Study Using CEITM Evaluation
venue: IEEE International Conference on Communications and Computer Science (InCCCS)
summary: Introduces CEITM, an evaluation framework that derives ground truth from semantic similarity instead of manual annotation, and uses it to benchmark CLIP, BLIP and ALBEF.

title: Predictive Cloud-Based Application for the Early Detection and Risk Stratification of Oral Cancer using Keratin Pearls, Multiple Nucleoli and Vascular Invasion
venue: IEEE International Conference on Computer Science and Engineering (ICSEC)
summary: A multi-model pipeline that classifies oral squamous lesions and detects three histopathological biomarkers to produce a pathologist-facing risk report.

title: Artificial Eye
summary: An assistive navigation aid for visually impaired users on a Raspberry Pi, combining object detection, OCR and text-to-speech.
